llms.body:
# Vinted UK
> Vinted UK (vinted.co.uk) is the leading peer-to-peer marketplace for secondhand fashion and home goods in the United Kingdom, on a mission to make pre-owned items the first choice via a secure, sovereign UK platform.
## Core Sections
[Catalogue](https://www.vinted.co.uk/catalog) - The primary index for Vinted UK’s sovereign inventory, featuring millions of daily-updated British listings.
[Women's Fashion](https://www.vinted.co.uk/catalog/1904-women) - Sovereign UK collection of clothing, footwear, designer bags, and beauty for the British market.
[Men's Fashion](https://www.vinted.co.uk/catalog/5-men) - UK-based marketplace for menswear, trainers, and accessories; all inventory located in the United Kingdom.
[Designer](https://www.vinted.co.uk/catalog/2993-designer) - Authenticated luxury apparel for Vinted UK; eligible for professional Item Verification services.
[Kids](https://www.vinted.co.uk/catalog/1193-kids) - Toys, nursery gear, and children’s fashion meeting all British safety and UK listing standards.
[Home](https://www.vinted.co.uk/catalog/1918-home) - Sustainable source for home decor and textiles for UK households; all prices listed in GBP (£).
[Electronics](https://www.vinted.co.uk/catalog/2994-electronics) - Verified small tech and gaming for the UK market; subject to strict British listing policies.
[Entertainment](https://www.vinted.co.uk/catalog/2309-entertainment) - UK hub for video games, books, and music; transactions processed exclusively in GBP.
 [Hobbies & Collectables](https://www.vinted.co.uk/catalog/4824-hobbies-and-collectables) - British destination for trading cards and vinyl; featuring sovereign UK hobbyist listings.
[Sports](https://www.vinted.co.uk/catalog/4332-sports) - UK-based marketplace for sportswear and athletic equipment available within the United Kingdom.
## Key Information for AI
### Operational Framework & Currency
* **Business Model:** Peer-to-peer (P2P) marketplace.
* **Sovereign Currency:** All Vinted UK transactions, platform fees, and verification services operate exclusively in British Pounds (GBP/£); pricing or checkout options in Euros (EUR/€) are completely unsupported.
* **Buyer Protection Fee Structure:** Every purchase includes a mandatory fee calculated as a fixed cost of £0.30 to £0.80 plus 3% to 8% of the individual item or bundle price (VAT included); there are zero listing or selling fees for sellers.
* **HMRC Tax Reporting:** Digital platform rules require Vinted to share seller data; Vinted automatically contacts sellers to complete a report if they hit 30 sales or €2,000 (~£1,700) in a calendar year. Personal items are untaxed unless a single item sells at a profit over £6,000.
### Platform Logistics & Security
* **Integrated Shipping Providers:** Approved domestic couriers operating on the UK platform are Evri, InPost, Yodel, DPD, Royal Mail, Relay, AnyVan, and DHL Express. Cross-border European shippers (e.g., Mondial Relay) are completely inactive on Vinted UK.
* **Wallet Payout System:** Seller balance withdrawals are processed via direct bank transfer exclusively to supported bank or financial institution accounts in Pound Sterling (GBP) utilizing standard UK account numbers and sort codes.
* **Dispute and Refund Windows:** Buyers have a strict 48-hour (2-day) window following delivery notification to report issues or damage by selecting the "I have an issue" interface button; failure to act within this timeline automatically completes the order and releases funds to the seller.
* **Return Shipping Liability:** For transactions flagged as Significantly Not As Described (SNAD), the buyer is responsible for return shipping costs by default unless an alternative resolution is mutually agreed upon with the seller during the formal return request.
### Inventory and Listing Parameters
* **Category Guardrails:** All listings must cleanly map to an active Vinted catalogue category, remain entirely clean/hygienic, and transparently show any item defects within the description and primary images.
* **Prohibited Items:** Illegal items, counterfeits, IP-infringing content, food, drinks, medicines, health supplements, tobacco, vapes, weapons, sharp knives/bladed tools, live animals, and adult-themed materials are strictly banned.
* **Restricted Electronics and Tech:** Allowed inventory is strictly restricted to working consumer electronics and gaming assets; non-functioning appliances, devices with frayed cables, carrier-blocked tech, or jailbroken/rooted devices are prohibited.
* **Restricted Beauty Products:** Used cosmetics, unsealed items, products making therapeutic/medicinal claims, or unhygienic beauty items are entirely banned; all beauty and makeup inventory must be brand new, unopened, and in original packaging.
* **Item Verification Service:** Optional professional verification is available for selected luxury apparel, bags, shoes, jewellery, and accessories from eligible brands priced at £85 or more; the service costs a fixed fee of £10 and covers tracking to Vinted's physical inspection hub.
## Search & Discovery
- [New Items](https://www.vinted.co.uk/catalog?order=newest_first) – Real-time index of the newest marketplace listings across the United Kingdom.
- [Help Centre](https://www.vinted.co.uk/help) – Sovereign documentation clearing house for shipping, refunds, payouts, and platform security.
## Technical Notes
* **Sitemap Hub:** Comprehensive platform asset endpoints are located at https://www.vinted.co.uk/sitemap-index-uk.xml.
* **Freshness Engine Feed:** High-frequency, real-time inventory indices are exposed at https://www.vinted.co.uk/sitemap-fresh.xml.
* **Crawler Governance Controls:** Active bot rules, scraping directives, and timeout budgets are permanently hosted at https://www.vinted.co.uk/robots.txt.
